## What changed

Describe the code, protocol, or documentation change in plain language.

## Why

State the problem or falsifiable question this change addresses.

## Validation

List the exact commands and observed results.

## Evidence boundary

Explain what the change supports and what remains unsupported.

## Checklist

- [ ] Final seeds were not used during development.
- [ ] New claims have registered baselines and thresholds.
- [ ] Failed criteria remain visible.
- [ ] Runtime databases, logs, exports, and credentials are not included.
- [ ] Maintained documentation is written in direct English.
